articles.title: HaikuS2S: A Cascaded System For Responding In Verse
articles.abstract: Expressive speech synthesis has advanced through prosody modeling, yet generating structured poetic speech, such as haiku, remains challenging. Prior work on prosody transfer improves expressiveness, and fine-tuned poetry TTS (text-to-speech) systems capture verse intonation. However, these models do not model haiku's 5-7-5 syllable structure or line-ending pauses. We present a cascaded system, HaikuS2S, combining ASR (automatic speech recognition), LLM (large language model)-generated haiku, and TTS fine-tuning on both prose and custom haiku datasets. Our evaluation focuses on emotion similarity, speech quality, and prosody alignment. In our experiments, we see that our prosody and tonal alignment improve significantly with our fine-tuned systems, particularly the one trained on both general poetry and haiku. We also see that we maintain similar emotion similarity scores across all systems.
articles.comment: Accepted to SLT 2026, Demo Track. 5 pages, 5 figures
articles.titleCn: HaikuS2S：一个逐级响应的诗歌生成系统
articles.abstractCn: 韵律合成技术已取得显著进步，但生成具有结构化诗意的语音，如俳句，仍具挑战性。以往关于韵律迁移的研究提升了表现力，而经过微调的诗歌合成系统则能捕捉诗句的韵律。然而，这些模型并未模拟俳句的5-7-5音节结构或行末停顿。我们提出了一种级联系统HaikuS2S，结合了自动语音识别（ASR）、大型语言模型（LLM）生成的俳句，以及在散文和自定义俳句数据集上对合成系统进行的微调。我们的评估聚焦于情感相似度、语音质量和韵律一致性。实验结果显示，经过微调的系统的韵律和音调一致性显著提升，尤其是同时接受了通用诗歌和俳句训练的系统。此外，所有系统在情感相似度得分上均保持了相似水平。

articles.title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
articles.abstract: Effective communication between users and AI agents is essential for human-AI collaboration. The XY problem is a well-known communication pitfall where a person asks about their attempted solution rather than their actual problem. We extend prior sycophancy evaluation to the XY problem in agentic settings, evaluating whether agents can resist plausible but misleading suggestions from users and communicate their reasoning. We introduce XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that can transform an existing benchmark into an XY problem evaluation. We evaluate five models across six diverse benchmark suites. Agents suffer large XY drops under XY mutation across benchmarks, with relative drops reaching up to 46.7%. With $τ^2$-bench, we further show that agent performance drops more when encountering a pedantic user who requires detailed explanations before approving a better solution. Our findings suggest that current agents lack the ability to effectively reason and communicate when facing misleading suggestions. A simple system instruction baseline that encourages awareness of XY problems only offers partial mitigation. Extensive trace analyses provide behavioral insights into how and why these XY drops occur across execution trajectories. Our results show that mitigating the XY problem remains challenging, requiring agents to both recognize user misdirection and clearly communicate the underlying problem.
articles.titleCn: XYEval：代理对坏建议说“是”
articles.abstractCn: 用户与AI代理之间有效的沟通对于人机协作至关重要。"XY问题"是一个著名的沟通陷阱，即用户询问他们尝试的解决方案而非实际问题。我们扩展了先前的奉承性评估至代理环境中的XY问题，评估代理是否能够抵制用户提出的看似合理但具有误导性的建议，并清晰表达其推理过程。我们引入了XYEval，一个元评估框架，可以将现有基准转化为XY问题评估。我们在六个不同的基准套件中评估了五种模型。在基准套件的XY变异下，代理的表现出现显著XY下降，相对下降幅度高达46.7%。通过τ²基准，我们进一步表明，当遇到要求详细解释才能批准更优解决方案的严谨用户时，代理的表现下降更为明显。我们的研究结果表明，当前代理在面对误导性建议时，缺乏有效推理和沟通的能力。一个简单的系统指令基线，仅鼓励对XY问题的意识，只能提供部分缓解。广泛的追踪分析提供了行为洞察，揭示了这些XY下降是如何以及为何在执行轨迹中发生的。我们的结果表明，缓解XY问题仍然具有挑战性，需要代理既能识别用户的误导，又能清晰传达潜在问题。

articles.title: Measuring the Assistant's Harmlessness Preferences on the User Turn
articles.abstract: Post-training turns a general next-token predictor into a chat model with a persistent assistant persona. If that persona is a character the model plays only on its own turns, its preferences should govern what the assistant says, not what the model predicts other speakers will say. We test this boundary and find that it does not hold: a safety-relevant preference of the assistant---for harmless over harmful tasks---shapes the model's predictions even on the user's turn, where the assistant is not the one speaking. We find that this preference is small or near-zero in pretrained base models, that it emerges through post-training, replicated across open-weight model families, grows with scale, and can be moved by narrow finetuning that never touches user turns. We claim that this is evidence that post-training does not merely install a shallow assistant persona, but instead generalises beyond just the local assistant turn, into the model's representation of the user.
articles.titleCn: 在用户回合中衡量助手的无害性偏好
articles.abstractCn: 训练后能够将通用的下一个词预测器转化为具有持久助手角色的聊天模型。如果该角色是模型只在自身回合中扮演的角色，那么它的偏好应该决定助手的发言内容，而不是模型预测其他说话者会说什么。我们测试了这个边界，发现它并不成立：助手的与安全相关的偏好——倾向于无害任务而非有害任务——会塑造模型在用户回合中的预测，即使助手并非在发言。我们发现这种偏好在前训练的基础模型中非常小或接近于零，它通过后训练产生，在开放权重模型家族中得以复制，随着规模的增长而增强，并且可以通过不触及用户回合的窄化微调进行移动。我们断言，这证明了后训练不仅安装了一个浅层的助手角色，而是超越了仅限于局部助手回合，扩展到了模型对用户表征的泛化。

articles.title: Time-Incremental Continued Pretraining of LLMs: Knowledge Updates Without Catastrophic Forgetting
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) drift out of date the moment their pretraining ends, yet retraining from scratch is prohibitively expensive. Continued pretraining (CPT) is the natural remedy, but it is typically evaluated through a continual learning lens that assumes disjoint data streams. This is a poor fit for time-incremental updates on web-scale crawls, where successive snapshots share substantial URL overlap by design. We study time-incremental CPT in this realistic regime: continued pretraining on FineWeb-Edu dumps drawn strictly from after each model's knowledge cutoff, evaluated across six open-weight models spanning three families (OLMo2, Llama-3.1/3.2, Gemma-3-1B) and four parameter scales (1B-3B-7B-8B). We organize our findings around four practical questions. (i) Is knowledge acquired? Yes, but heterogeneously, and without catastrophic forgetting: five of six models also improve on pre-cutoff factual recall, and the gains track pretraining saturation (driven primarily by token budget per parameter). (ii) What does it cost? Almost nothing: the macro-average across a thirteen-task suite stays within 0.01 of the base for every model. (iii) What is the recipe? Data quality dominates quantity (a curated 6B-token slice matches a broader 40B one); the optima for knowledge acquisition and general capability are separated by roughly an order of magnitude in learning rate; and LoRA at sufficient rank matches full CPT. (iv) Does it survive deployment? CPT gains transfer through SFT, while DPO's effect is family-dependent. Together, these results paint a more optimistic picture of time-incremental CPT than the prior continual learning literature suggests.
articles.titleCn: 基于时间的持续预训练：LLM的知识更新而不遗忘灾难
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）在预训练结束后立即过时，而从零开始重新训练成本高昂。持续预训练（CPT）是自然的解决方案，但通常通过假设数据流不重叠的持续学习视角进行评估。这对于网络规模爬虫的时间增量更新并不适用，因为连续的快照在设计上共享大量URL重叠。我们在此现实场景下研究了时间增量CPT：在严格从每个模型的认知截止点之后抽取的FineWeb-Edu数据集上进行持续预训练，并在六个开放权重模型（跨越三个系列：OLMo2、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-3-1B）和四个参数规模（1B-3B-7B-8B）上进行评估。我们围绕四个实际问题组织我们的发现。(i) 是否获取了知识？是的，但异构化，且没有灾难性遗忘：六分之五的模型在截止点前的事实回忆上也有所改进，且收益与预训练饱和度（主要由每个参数的token预算驱动）相匹配。(ii) 成本如何？几乎为零：在十三项任务的宏观平均中，每个模型的基准值保持在0.01以内。(iii) 方程式是什么？数据质量胜于数量（一个经过筛选的6B-token切片与更广泛的40B切片相当）；知识获取和通用能力的最优学习率相差约一个数量级；LoRA在足够高的排名上与完整CPT相当。(iv) 它能否经受部署？CPT通过SFT获得迁移增益，而DPO的效果则系列依赖。这些结果共同描绘了比先前的持续学习文献更乐观的时间增量CPT图景。

articles.title: this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
articles.abstract: Software delegates more of its branches to models every year: which queue a ticket enters, whether a command is safe to run, whether a claim clears without a person. What the program needs back is not prose. It is one of n declared options and a number it can threshold. Today that costs a round trip to a frontier model -- hundreds of milliseconds, a per-token bill, and a parser -- for a question that is usually a conjunction of three clauses. this-that-model-1.0 is a 2B-parameter typed decision model. Its answer is read directly from the hidden state at a designated position and restricted to the option set the caller declared, so no text is generated, nothing can be malformed, and every question in a request is answered in the same forward pass. It decides in 30.9 ms on one laptop GPU and generates zero output tokens doing it, where a frontier API call costs 8758 ms and the hosted systems that answer these questions well spend between 21 and 212 generated tokens per question thinking first, billed for every one. It sustains 32 decisions per second on one consumer GPU and never lets the state leave the machine. On a third party's recorded cohort of 68 decision questions, on their inputs and their wording, it scores 0.941 with a Brier score of 0.042, against 0.765 and 0.133 for the hosted service Jev on the same items. One pass of our 42-family internal suite takes 32 seconds and 0.000217 USD of electricity; the most accurate hosted model we measured needs 155.2 minutes and 10.636 USD. We also report where it loses. On multi-step arithmetic, which a single forward pass cannot carry intermediate results through, it scores 0.560 against their 0.98 to 1.00, and a targeted second training round improved the five task families it was written for and transferred to none of the other 13. The model is open-sourced in https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0
articles.titleCn: this-that-model-1.0：一个类型化的决策模型，可在30毫秒内做出决策，成本仅为百万分之一美分
articles.abstractCn: 软件每年将更多分支委托给模型：哪个队列接收票证、命令是否安全、声明是否无需人工即可清除。程序需要返回的不是散文。它需要一个预先声明的选项之一和一个它可以设定阈值的数字。今天，这需要一次往返到前沿模型——数百毫秒的延迟、每个令牌的费用以及解析器——来回答通常由三个子句组成的简单问题。"this-that-model-1.0"是一个2B参数的决策模型。它的答案直接从指定位置的隐藏状态读取，并限制在调用者声明的选项集中，因此不会生成文本，不会出现格式错误，并且请求中的每个问题都在同一个前向传递中回答。它在单块笔记本电脑GPU上以30.9毫秒的速度做出决策，同时不生成任何输出令牌，而前沿API调用需要8758毫秒，而回答这些问题的托管系统在思考后需要花费每问题21到212个生成令牌，并且每个都计费。它在单个消费级GPU上以每秒32个决策的速度运行，并且永远不会让状态离开机器。在一个第三方记录的68个决策问题队列中，根据他们的输入和措辞，它在0.941的Brier分数下得分，而托管服务Jev在相同项目中的得分为0.765和0.133。我们42家族内部套件的单一传递需要32秒和0.000217美元的电力；我们测量中最准确的托管模型需要155.2分钟和10.636美元。我们还报告了它的弱点。在多步算术中，单次前向传递无法传递中间结果，它的得分为0.560，而他们的得分为0.98到1.00，并且有针对性的二次训练轮改进了它所编写的五个任务家族，而没有转移到其他13个家族。该模型已开源在https://huggingface.co/flock-io/this-that-model-1.0。

articles.title: Q-TIE: A Lightweight and Generalizable Re-ranking Framework for Temporal Information Retrieval
articles.abstract: Temporal Information Retrieval (TIR) has been increasingly critical given the rise of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Since temporally mismatched evidence can be highly misleading, TIR aims to retrieve documents that are both semantically and temporally relevant to a query. Two TIR paradigms have emerged - temporal retrievers and temporal re-rankers - differing in how temporal relevance is modeled. While these paradigms provide complementary strengths, our analysis reveals that each alone falls short of robust TIR: temporal retrievers provide flexible query understanding via learned representations, but often fail to explicitly account for temporal constraints; temporal re-rankers can enforce such constraints more explicitly, but often rely on predefined re-ranking rules. To address this, we propose Q-TIE, a re-ranking framework based on learned Temporal Intent Extraction (TIE). By introducing a TIE model that maps each query's temporal constraint into a unified interval representation (i.e., $\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$), Q-TIE generalizes beyond predefined rules via model-based learning while explicitly modeling temporal constraints as a separate signal - jointly achieving what each paradigm typically trades off. Experiments demonstrate that Q-TIE consistently outperforms existing TIR methods with stronger generalizability across temporal query types, and provides a lightweight yet effective add-on for temporally-aware RAG pipelines. Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE.
articles.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code: https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE
articles.titleCn: Q-TIE：一种用于时间信息检索的轻量级和可泛化的重排序框架
articles.abstractCn: 随着检索增强生成（RAG）的兴起，时间信息检索（TIR）变得日益关键。由于时间不匹配的证据可能具有高度误导性，TIR旨在检索与查询在语义和时间上都相关的文档。已出现两种TIR范式——时间检索器和时间重排序器——它们在如何建模时间相关性的方式上存在差异。尽管这些范式提供了互补的优势，但我们的分析表明，单独使用任何一种都难以实现稳健的TIR：时间检索器通过学习到的表示提供灵活的查询理解，但通常无法明确考虑时间约束；时间重排序器可以更明确地执行此类约束，但通常依赖于预定义的重排序规则。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于学习时间意图提取（TIE）的重排序框架Q-TIE。通过引入一个将每个查询的时间约束映射到统一区间表示（即$\langle t_{start}, t_{end} \rangle$）的TIE模型，Q-TIE通过基于模型的 学习超越预定义规则，同时将时间约束显式建模为独立信号——实现了每种范式通常需要权衡的目标。实验表明，Q-TIE始终优于现有的TIR方法，在时间查询类型上具有更强的泛化能力，并为时间感知RAG流程提供了一个轻量级且有效的附加方案。代码：https://github.com/ssoy0701/Q-TIE。

articles.title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
articles.abstract: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.
articles.titleCn: 从联合国减少灾害风险署报告到事件记录：基于模式约束的大型语言模型提取地理参考灾害
articles.abstractCn: 灾害风险降低档案以散文形式描述灾害事件，而EM-DAT（Delforge等人，2025年）等数据库无法直接导入这些信息。我们提出了一种LLM处理流程，该流程使用受控的灾害词汇和固定架构生成候选地理参考事件记录，并保留证据供审核。应用于由联合国减少灾害风险署（UNDRR）管理的知识中心PreventionWeb的10,000份文档，该流程从1,913份文档中生成3,572条记录，涵盖24种灾害类型，并将81%的地点提及解析为OpenStreetMap几何形状。在217份分层参考文档中的171份人类确认的文档窗口上，GPT-5实现了86.0%的池化属性$F_1$，而spaCy-gazetteer基线仅为44.2%。评估将文档内的灾害类别、地点字符串和事件年份组合在一起，而不评估它们与单个事件的分配。在十个LLM中，GPT-5.4排名最高（86.6% $F_1$）。GPT-5的逐字证据出现率为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%，用于衡量文本可追溯性而不建立属性支持。我们报告了生产失败模式以及自动标签和地点规则合规性检查。提示、架构和输出将发布，以供适应国家报告档案。

articles.title: Impact Is Not Invalidation: Ask About the Claim, Not the Diff
articles.abstract: Memory systems for coding agents must decide, when a repository changes, which of their stored claims have become false. Content anchoring invalidates a claim whenever the artifact it came from changes, which fires constantly. Semantic-equivalence classification asks whether a diff preserves behavior, a question about the diff rather than about any stored claim. We show the second signal fails for a reason unrelated to model capability: asked whether a commit preserves behavior, five models spanning a 40x price range fire on 59-72% of real commits and reach precisions of only 0.291 to 0.329 against a 0.25 base rate. Asked instead whether one specific claim still holds, the same models on the same diffs reach 0.705 to 0.974. A control that hands the behavior-preservation judge the claim text, changing only the question, moves precision by 0.010 and 0.016; changing the question moves it by 0.49 and 0.65. We also compare against pytest-testmon, a deployed regression-test selector with coverage-derived dependency data: it reaches 0.868 recall at 0.415 precision, so near-complete knowledge of what a change can reach does not identify what it falsifies. Ground truth is execution, not annotation: a claim is a test function passing at commit t, and it has flipped if that same assertion text fails at t+1. Building this required an observation we did not find in prior work. On a CI-gated mainline a commit that leaves a pre-existing test failing cannot merge, so the naive construction has an empty positive class by design. We report 10,369 claims with 184 execution-verified flips mined from 23 Python libraries, splits held out by repository, a post-knowledge-cutoff split, a shuffled-diff null, a paraphrase control, and a leave-one-repository-out analysis over 17 repositories.
articles.titleCn: 影响不等于否定：询问声明，而非差异
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理的内存系统必须在存储库发生变化时，判断其存储的哪些声明已变为错误。内容锚定机制会在其来源的工件发生变化时使声明失效，这会持续触发。语义等价分类则询问差异是否保留了行为，这是一个关于差异而非任何存储声明的疑问。我们展示了第二种信号失效的原因与模型能力无关：当询问提交是否保留行为时，五个跨越40倍价格范围的模型在59-72%的真实提交上触发，并达到0.291到0.329的精度，而基准率为0.25。相反，当询问特定声明是否仍然成立时，相同的模型在相同的差异上达到0.705到0.974的精度。一个控制机制将行为保留裁判的声明文本交给裁判，仅改变问题，精度提升0.010和0.016；而改变问题则使精度提升0.49和0.65。我们还与pytest-testmon进行了比较，这是一个已部署的回归测试选择器，具有基于覆盖范围的依赖数据：它在0.415的精度下达到0.868的召回率，因此对变更可能达到的结果的完整了解并不能识别其错误的内容。真实情况是执行而非标注：一个声明是在提交t时通过测试函数，如果同一断言文本在t+1时失败，则该声明已翻转。构建这一点需要我们未在先前工作中发现的观察。在一个CI门控的主干上，一个导致现有测试失败的提交无法合并，因此原始构建的设计上正类为空。我们报告了从23个Python库中挖掘的10,369个声明，其中包含184个经过执行验证的翻转，按存储库进行分割，一个知识截止后的分割，一个打乱差异的空控制，一个同义替换控制，以及跨17个存储库的留一存储库分析。

articles.title: Federated Multilingual Speech-LLMs: Architecture and Aggregation Strategy Benchmarking
articles.abstract: We present a comprehensive benchmark of Federated Learning (FL) for multilingual Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), evaluating four Speech-LLM architectures on the Multilingual LibriSpeech dataset. We compare FedAvg and FedProx across frozen and unfrozen encoder configurations, demonstrating that optimized learning rates are critical for performance. Specifically, independently tuning the learning rates for the speech encoder, connector, and decoder yields the lowest error rates, with full three-component adaptation (LoRA for encoder and decoder, full training for the connector) producing the best FL results. We observe that FedProx efficacy is architecture-dependent, providing notable advantages in multilingual pre-trained architectures (e.g., EuroLLM over TinyLlama when keeping the encoder fixed); this indicates that LLM backbone capacity plays a key role in mediating resilience to heterogeneous data distributions. These findings offer concrete design guidance for deploying multilingual Speech-LLMs in privacy-sensitive, distributed environments.
articles.titleCn: 联邦多语言语音LLM：架构和聚合策略基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 我们针对多语言自动语音识别（ASR）任务，对联邦学习（FL）进行了全面基准测试，并在多语言LibriSpeech数据集上评估了四种Speech-LLM架构。我们比较了FedAvg和FedProx在冻结编码器和非冻结编码器配置下的表现，证明优化学习率对性能至关重要。具体而言，分别独立调整语音编码器、连接器和解码器的学习率可得到最低错误率，而完整的三组件自适应（编码器和解码器使用LoRA，连接器进行全训练）产生了最佳的联邦学习结果。我们观察到FedProx的有效性具有架构依赖性，在多语言预训练架构（例如，当固定编码器时，EuroLLM优于TinyLlama）中表现出显著优势；这表明LLM主干容量在调节对异构数据分布的鲁棒性方面起着关键作用。这些发现为在隐私敏感的分布式环境中部署多语言Speech-LLM提供了具体的设计指导。

articles.title: FLARE: A Full-Lifecycle Dense Supervision Paradigm for Long-Horizon Coding Agents via Generative Reward Model
articles.abstract: While test-time scaling enhances Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon software engineering (SWE), sparse binary rewards (Pass/Fail) create a severe credit assignment crisis and waste failed exploratory trajectories. Current trajectory optimization and scaling methods are costly and structurally limited, relying on heuristic state reuse without causal diagnosis or delayed scalar scoring without actionable online guidance. We propose FLARE (Full-Lifecycle Alignment and Reward Engine), a novel dense supervision paradigm driven by a lightweight Generative Reward Model (GRM). First, RADAR, an offline causal-aware diagnostic framework, extracts high-fidelity, hindsight-free supervision through causal-chain backtracking to distill a GRM providing real-time, step-level risk feedback. Second, FLARE uses this GRM to continuously optimize the agent across its entire lifecycle. During inference, FLARE acts as an Active Scaffold, autonomously intercepting high-risk generation steps for localized breakpoint re-execution, drastically reducing compute overhead. During post-training, the GRM's structured signals serve as process-supervised reranking scores for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and step-level dense rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL), mitigating policy collapse in sparse environments. Extensive evaluations show that FLARE establishes a new Pareto frontier across the agent lifecycle: FLARE (N=1) outperforms Global Rollout (N=5) with a 5x reduction in token consumption. Extending FLARE to training overcomes the sparse reward problem in long-horizon interactive tasks, delivering relative performance gains of 19.13% in SFT through process-aware data curation and a consistent 9.19% improvement in RL.
articles.titleCn: FLARE：一种基于生成式奖励模型的长期目标代码代理全生命周期密集监督范式
articles.abstractCn: 虽然测试时缩放能够增强长时程软件工程（SWE）中的大型语言模型（LLM）代理，但稀疏二元奖励（通过/失败）会引发严重的信用分配危机并浪费失败的探索轨迹。当前的轨迹优化和缩放方法成本高昂且结构受限，依赖于启发式状态重用而缺乏因果诊断或延迟标量评分而缺乏可操作的在线指导。我们提出了FLARE（全生命周期对齐和奖励引擎），这是一种由轻量级生成式奖励模型（GRM）驱动的全新密集监督范式。首先，RADAR，一个离线的因果感知诊断框架，通过因果链回溯提取高保真、无后见之明的监督，提炼出一个GRM，提供实时、步级的风险反馈。其次，FLARE利用该GRM在整个生命周期内持续优化代理。在推理过程中，FLARE充当主动脚手架，自主拦截高风险生成步骤进行局部断点重执行，大幅降低计算开销。在训练后，GRM的结构化信号作为监督微调（SFT）的过程监督重排序分数，以及强化学习（RL）的步级密集奖励，缓解稀疏环境中的策略崩溃。广泛的评估表明，FLARE在代理生命周期中建立了新的帕累托前沿：FLARE（N=1）在消耗token减少5倍的条件下优于全局展开（N=5）。将FLARE扩展到训练中克服了长时程交互任务中的稀疏奖励问题，通过过程感知数据管理在SFT中实现了19.13%的相对性能提升，并在RL中持续改善了9.19%。

articles.title: Constrained Decoding Eliminates Structural Failures in Small LLMs but Reveals a Scale-Dependent Semantic Gap
articles.abstract: Small open-source large language models (LLMs) in the 0.6B-4B parameter range are increasingly deployed for structured output generation (JSON, function calling, data extraction), yet little is known about how constrained decoding (CD) interacts with model scale in this regime. We benchmark five models from three families across 14 structured-output tasks under three decoding conditions (native, Outlines, XGrammar). We introduce a two-axis evaluation that separates structural correctness (schema validity) from semantic correctness (content accuracy). We find that CD eliminates all structural failures across all models (schema validity: 78.6-92.9% to 100%), but content accuracy reveals a persistent semantic gap that is scale-dependent: type coercion failures are fully CD-rescuable, while instruction-semantic failures (e.g., multi-step function calling) remain CD-resistant. Schema conformance is necessary but not sufficient for semantic correctness; CD's reach ends exactly where schema conformance ends.
articles.comment: 6 pages, ACL format Code and task suite: https://github.com/CruiseDevice/small-llm-structured-benchmark (tag v1.0)
articles.titleCn: 约束解码消除了小型大型语言模型中的结构失效，但揭示了与规模相关的语义差距
articles.abstractCn: 在0.6B-4B参数范围内，小型开源大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于生成结构化输出（JSON、函数调用、数据提取），然而对于在此范围内约束解码（CD）与模型规模如何相互作用，人们知之甚少。我们在三种解码条件下（原生、Outlines、XGrammar）针对14项结构化输出任务，对三个系列中的五个模型进行了基准测试。我们引入了一种双轴评估方法，将结构正确性（模式有效性）与语义正确性（内容准确性）分开。我们发现，CD消除了所有模型中的所有结构化错误（模式有效性：从78.6-92.9%提升至100%），但内容准确性揭示了一种持续存在的、与规模相关的语义差距：类型强制失败的错误完全可以通过CD解决，而指令-语义失败（例如，多步函数调用）仍然对CD具有抵抗力。模式符合性对于语义正确性是必要的，但不是充分的；CD的作用范围正好在模式符合性结束的地方。

articles.title: GRACE: Grounded Adversarial Reasoning over Canadian Law
articles.abstract: Large language models have shown strong performance across a range of legal tasks, but existing benchmarks rarely evaluate the ability to take and defend a legal position, reason under incomplete information, or synthesize multiple statutory provisions. This gap is particularly pronounced for Canadian law, which remains underrepresented in legal NLP. We introduce GRACE (Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples), a dataset of 1,915 question-reasoning-answer instances grounded in Canadian federal legislation. GRACE covers three reasoning modes: adversarial advocacy, uncertainty, and applied reasoning. We develop a pipeline that partitions raw statutory text, generates scenario-based questions and reasoning, and filters examples through model-free citation verification and LLM-based quality auditing. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune CLeAR-4B (Canadian Legal Adversarial Reasoning), a lightweight model for grounded legal reasoning, and evaluate it against the unmodified Qwen3-4B base model in open- and closed-book settings. CLeAR-4B substantially improves agreement with teacher outputs and statutory citation behavior when the relevant act text is provided, while its grounding degrades sharply when the statute is withheld. These results suggest that GRACE can support the development of lightweight legal models that reason more effectively from supplied statutory text.
articles.titleCn: GRACE：基于加拿大法律的接地气对抗推理
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在多种法律任务中表现出色，但现有的基准测试很少评估其采取和捍卫法律立场、在信息不完整情况下进行推理或综合多个法规条款的能力。这一差距在加拿大法律中尤为明显，加拿大法律在法律自然语言处理领域仍存在代表性不足的问题。我们介绍了GRACE（Grounded Reasoning Adversarial Canadian LEgal examples），这是一个基于加拿大联邦立法的1,915个问答推理实例的数据集。GRACE涵盖三种推理模式：对抗性辩护、不确定性以及应用推理。我们开发了一个流程，将原始法规文本进行分割，生成基于场景的问句和推理，并通过无模型的引文验证和基于大型语言模型的品质审计来筛选实例。作为概念验证，我们对CLeAR-4B（加拿大法律对抗性推理）进行了微调，这是一个用于基于事实的法律推理的轻量级模型，并在开放书和封闭书环境下将其与未经修改的Qwen3-4B基础模型进行评估。当提供相关法案文本时，CLeAR-4B在教师输出和法规引文行为上显著提高一致性，但当法案文本被隐藏时，其基于事实的推理能力急剧下降。这些结果表明，GRACE可以支持开发更有效地从提供的法规文本中进行推理的轻量级法律模型。

articles.title: STEVE: Stabilizing Textual Gradient-Based Prompt Optimization via Error-Driven Refinement and Regularized Verification
articles.abstract: Textual-gradient methods automate prompt optimization through natural-language feedback, but their iterative updates can be unstable. We identify two sources of this instability: noisy gradients produced from already-correct examples and over-specialization to hard cases that degrades performance on simpler inputs. We introduce STEVE, a stabilization framework with two coupled mechanisms. Error-Driven Refinement generates gradients only from incorrectly handled examples, concentrating updates on informative failures. Regularized Verification treats every update as provisional and accepts it only when improvement on hard cases does not cause unacceptable regression on a preservation set. Across ten reasoning benchmarks, three evaluator/optimizer models, and established prompt-optimization baselines, STEVE reduces degradation and produces more robust prompts. Additional evaluations with gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4 on symbolic reasoning, GSM8K-Platinum, and DS-1000 show that these gains persist with newer models and larger test sets. STEVE therefore provides a practical way to improve the stability and effectiveness of textual-gradient prompt optimization.
articles.comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: AACL-IJCNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: STEVE：基于错误驱动精炼和正则化验证的文本梯度提示优化稳定方法
articles.abstractCn: 文本梯度方法通过自然语言反馈自动化提示优化，但其迭代更新可能不稳定。我们识别出两种不稳定的来源：已正确处理的示例产生的噪声梯度，以及对难例过度特殊化导致在简单输入上的性能下降。我们引入STEVE，一个具有两个耦合机制的稳定化框架。错误驱动精炼仅从处理不当的示例生成梯度，将更新集中于信息量大的失败案例。正则化验证将每次更新视为临时状态，仅在难例上的改进不会对保留集造成不可接受的回归时才接受更新。在十个推理基准、三种评估器/优化器模型以及成熟的提示优化基线测试中，STEVE减少了性能下降并生成了更鲁棒的提示。额外的评估使用gpt-5.4-mini/gpt-5.4在符号推理、GSM8K-Platinum和DS-1000上，表明这些收益在新模型和更大的测试集上依然持续。因此，STEVE提供了一种实用方法来提高文本梯度提示优化的稳定性和有效性。

articles.title: Financial Language Models as Applied Artificial Intelligence Systems for News-Based Trading under Market Frictions
articles.abstract: Financial language models can transform unstructured firm-specific news into structured decision signals, but financial AI research lacks an integrated deployment framework for evaluating whether those signals remain useful in financial decision systems. Computer science research has developed strong methods for time-series forecasting, text classification, multimodal stock prediction, graph-based market modeling, and machine-learning operations, yet these streams do not provide a domain-specific protocol that jointly tests financial language-model outputs under event-time observability, probability calibration, execution timing, transaction costs, liquidity constraints, capacity limits, operational diagnostics, and statistical inference. We introduce MFAST, a Market-Friction-Aware Sentiment-to-Trading framework that converts timestamped financial text into auditable, reproducible, and market-feasible trading decisions. The application is news-based trading, where firm-specific text must be linked to securities before portfolio decisions can be evaluated. The framework links Refinitiv News Analytics to Center for Research in Security Prices (CRSP) equity data, restricts the primary out-of-sample evaluation to post-release news outside disclosed foundation-model data-freshness periods, and adds a public replication arm using open financial text and public price data. Results show that decoder-only language models outperform encoder baselines and dictionary sentiment in classification, calibration, return prediction, and net portfolio performance, while operational diagnostics reveal trade-offs among accuracy, latency, memory, throughput, and inference cost. The paper shows that credible evaluation of financial language models requires an end-to-end engineering approach combining language understanding, temporal discipline, market-friction-aware deployment, and reproducible validation.

articles.titleCn: 基于市场摩擦的新闻交易应用型人工智能系统——金融语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 金融语言模型能够将非结构化的公司特定新闻转化为结构化的决策信号，但金融人工智能研究缺乏一个综合部署框架来评估这些信号在金融决策系统中的有效性。计算机科学研究已发展出强大的时间序列预测、文本分类、多模态股票预测、基于图的市 场建模和机器学习操作等方法，但这些方法并未提供特定领域的协议，以在事件时间可观察性、概率校准、执行时间、交易成本、流动性约束、容量限制、运营诊断和统计推断等方面联合测试金融语言模型的输出。我们介绍了MFAST，一个考虑市场摩擦的情感到交易的框架，该框架将时间戳化的金融文本转化为可审计、可复现且市场可行的交易决策。该应用基于新闻进行交易，其中公司特定文本必须与证券关联，才能评估投资组合决策。该框架将Refinitiv新闻分析链接到安全价格研究中心（CRSP）的股票数据，将主要的外部样本评估限制在披露的基础模型数据新鲜度期之外的发布后新闻，并添加了一个使用公开金融文本和公开价格数据的公共复制分支。结果表明，仅解码器语言模型在分类、校准、回报预测和净投资组合表现方面优于编码器基线和词典情感，而运营诊断揭示了准确率、延迟、内存、吞吐量和推理成本之间的权衡。该论文表明，对金融语言模型的可信评估需要一个结合语言理解、时间纪律、考虑市场摩擦的部署和可复现验证的端到端工程方法。

articles.title: Distill What You Trust: Reliability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
articles.abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation allows a student to learn from complementary specialists on its own trajectories. Domain-routed approaches, however, select one teacher per example and keep it fixed throughout the response. This design both depends on labels that mixed training corpora often lack and cannot adapt teacher selection when the expertise required changes within a trajectory. We propose \textbf{TrustMOPD}, which replaces example-level teacher selection with label-free, token-level supervision allocation. At each student-generated prefix, TrustMOPD uses each specialist's RL-induced displacement from a shared pre-RL reference as a proxy for local reliability, calibrates these scores across teachers, and constructs a weighted distillation target. Across mathematics, code, and instruction following, TrustMOPD outperforms the strongest label-free baseline, increasing the recovery ratio from $54.4\%$ to $91.5\%$ on \textsc{SingleCap} and from $54.5\%$ to $98.0\%$ on \textsc{MultiCap}, while approaching label-based MOPD on \textsc{SingleCap}. Randomizing token-level weights independently of the student-generated prefix performs no better than uniform weighting, supporting the importance of conditioning supervision on the evolving generation context.
articles.titleCn: 提炼你所信任的：可靠性感知的多导师在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 多教师在线策略蒸馏允许学生在其自身轨迹上从互补的专家那里学习。然而，领域路由方法为每个示例选择一个固定的教师，并在整个响应过程中保持不变。这种设计既依赖于混合训练语料库中通常缺乏的标签，又无法在轨迹中所需的专业知识变化时调整教师选择。我们提出了\textbf{TrustMOPD}，它用无标签的、基于标记级的监督分配来替代示例级的教师选择。在每次学生生成的前缀中，TrustMOPD使用每个专家从共享的预RL参考点出发的RL诱导位移作为局部可靠性的代理，跨教师校准这些分数，并构建一个加权蒸馏目标。在数学、代码和指令遵循任务中，TrustMOPD优于最强的无标签基线，在\textsc{SingleCap}上将恢复率从$54.4\%$提高到$91.5\%$，在\textsc{MultiCap}上将恢复率从$54.5\%$提高到$98.0\%$，同时在\textsc{SingleCap}上接近基于标签的MOPD。独立于学生生成的前缀随机化标记级权重与均匀加权表现无异，这支持了监督条件化于演变生成上下文的重要性。

articles.title: Beyond Relevance: Structured Semantic Supervision for Product Search with LLM-Augmented Annotations
articles.abstract: E-commerce search requires distinguishing products that are merely related to a query from those that directly satisfy the user's shopping intent. We augment query-product pairs with structured LLM-generated query and product attributes and human-validated relevance, explanations, and centrality judgments, and evaluate these signals using a simple dual-encoder retriever and MLP re-ranker. On an augmented subset of ESCI, a human-feature oracle reaches $0.9382$ nDCG@10, while a human-free trained $Q+P$ configuration reaches $0.9258$. Synthetic approximations of the human signals reach $0.9150$ overall but provide substantial gains for difficult, low-performing queries. Ablations show that most of the oracle improvement comes from post-edited explanations and annotator comments rather than the scalar centrality feature, suggesting that LLMs are most useful for exposing and approximating structured semantic supervision rather than replacing human judgment directly.
articles.titleCn: 超越相关性：基于LLM增强标注的产品搜索结构化语义监督
articles.abstractCn: 电子商务搜索需要区分仅与查询相关联的产品和那些直接满足用户购物意图的产品。我们通过为查询-产品对添加结构化的LLM生成的查询和产品属性，以及人工验证的相关性、解释和中心性判断，来增强这些对。我们使用简单的双编码器检索器和MLP重新排序器来评估这些信号。在一个增强的ESCI子集上，人工特征预言机达到了0.9382的nDCG@10，而一个无人工训练的Q+P配置达到了0.9258。人工信号的综合近似值总体上达到了0.9150，但对困难、表现不佳的查询提供了显著的提升。消融实验表明，预言机的改进主要来自后编辑的解释和标注员评论，而不是标量中心性特征，这表明LLM在揭示和近似结构化的语义监督方面最有用，而不是直接替代人工判断。

articles.title: Are Human-Aligned Models Models of Humans? A Turing-Test Gap in Preference Alignment
articles.abstract: Human-feedback alignment has made language models useful assistants and is commonly described as aligning them with humans. However, the responses people prefer from an AI need not be the responses they themselves would give. We distinguish alignment with human preferences from alignment with human behavior, and show that alignment with human preferences can make model behavior less human-like even when both preferences and responses come entirely from humans. We call this the Turing-test gap. We show that preference alignment preserves the human response distribution only under a restrictive condition, and find no consistent evidence that real human preferences satisfy it. Empirically, the loss of human-response likelihood increases with the strength of preference weighting, regardless of its direction, and the gap also appears under standard DPO. These results establish human-likeness as an explicit dimension of alignment rather than something assumed to follow from preference alignment.
articles.titleCn: 人类对齐模型是人类模型吗？偏好对齐中的图灵测试差距
articles.abstractCn: 人类反馈对齐使语言模型成为有用的助手，通常被描述为将模型与人类对齐。然而，人们期望AI给出的回应未必是他们自己会给出的回应。我们将与人类偏好对齐与与人类行为对齐区分开来，并表明，即使偏好和回应都完全来自人类，与人类偏好对齐也会使模型行为更不像人类。我们称之为图灵测试差距。我们证明，偏好对齐仅在严格条件下才保留人类回应分布，并且发现没有一致证据表明真实人类偏好满足该条件。实证上，无论偏好权重的方向如何，人类回应可能性的损失随着偏好权重的强度增加而增加，标准DPO下也存在这种差距。这些结果将人类相似性确立为对齐的一个明确维度，而不是假设偏好对齐会自然带来人类相似性。

articles.title: Collapse, Not Complexity: Failure-Conditioned Decomposition Repair for End-to-End Document Parsing
articles.abstract: End-to-end document parsers increasingly offer an optional reasoning mode for complex pages. On a 180-page entropy-stratified discovery sample with one frozen 4B checkpoint, complexity is the wrong decision variable. Reasoning lowers mean quality by 2.21 Overall at 1.54x tokens; a preregistered input-only model cannot predict its signed benefit (held-out AUROC 0.47, indistinguishable from chance). The benefit concentrates on pages whose ordinary pass has already collapsed, and they do not look complex: shared collapses have lower layout entropy than healthy ones yet consume 19x the tokens as degenerate repetition that doubling the budget does not cure. Switching modes rarely repairs them: 83% recur under reasoning. We instead detect collapse from the ordinary-pass trace, decompose the page by projection, and re-parse each region. Repair gains 1.40 Overall (95% CI [0.68, 2.16]) at 1.13x tokens, replicates across three checkpoints, and, with all parameters frozen, gains 2.41 (CI [1.64, 3.46]) on the remaining 1,175 benchmark pages.

articles.titleCn: 崩溃而非复杂：针对端到端文档解析的失效条件分解修复
articles.abstractCn: 端到端文档解析器越来越多地为复杂页面提供可选的推理模式。在一个包含180页熵分层发现样本且有一个冻结的4B检查点的实验中，复杂度作为决策变量是不恰当的。推理模式将平均质量降低了2.21，在1.54倍的token数量下；一个预先注册的仅输入模型无法预测其符号收益（排除的AUROC为0.47，与随机猜测无法区分）。收益集中在那些常规解析已经崩溃的页面上，而这些页面并不显得复杂：共享崩溃的页面布局熵低于健康页面，但消耗的token数量是退化重复的19倍，即使加倍预算也无法修复。切换模式很少能修复它们：83%在推理模式下仍然重复出现。我们改为从常规解析的跟踪中检测崩溃，通过投影分解页面，并重新解析每个区域。修复效果提升了1.40（95%置信区间[0.68, 2.16]），在1.13倍的token数量下，并在三个检查点中重复验证，且在所有参数冻结的情况下，在剩余的1,175个基准页面上提升了2.41（置信区间[1.64, 3.46]）。

articles.title: On the Efficiency-Safety Dilemma in Large Reasoning Models
articles.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) incur high inference costs, often mitigated by efficiency techniques like quantization and pruning. However, the impact of these techniques on model adversarial robustness remains largely unexplored. This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the interplay between efficiency, jailbreak vulnerability, and reasoning in LRMs. We find that while efficiency methods seemingly reduce the success rate of jailbreak attacks, this improvement is often superficial. It largely arises from degraded reasoning capabilities leading to "attempted but failed" malicious responses, rather than an increase in genuine alignment. Mechanistic analysis of representational drift confirms this, revealing a strict coupling between reasoning capability loss and the model's inability to maintain malicious semantic trajectories. Additionally, we identify quantization with pruning as the optimal strategy to balance efficiency and robustness. These findings clarify the distinction between true safety alignment and capability-induced failure, providing an empirical foundation for LRM deployment.
articles.titleCn: 大型推理模型中的效率-安全困境
articles.abstractCn: 大型推理模型（LRMs）的推理成本很高，通常通过量化、剪枝等效率技术来缓解。然而，这些技术对模型对抗鲁棒性的影响尚未得到充分探索。本研究首次全面分析了效率、越狱漏洞和LRMs推理之间的相互作用。我们发现，虽然效率方法似乎降低了越狱攻击的成功率，但这种改进往往是表面的。这主要源于推理能力的下降导致“尝试但失败”的恶意响应，而非真正的对齐增强。表征漂移的机制分析证实了这一点，揭示了推理能力丧失与模型无法维持恶意语义轨迹之间的严格耦合。此外，我们确定了量化与剪枝相结合是平衡效率与鲁棒性的最佳策略。这些发现厘清了真实安全对齐与能力诱导失败之间的区别，为LRMs的部署提供了实证基础。

articles.title: Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization
articles.abstract: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($ρ_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. Under a C4-to-LongBench shift, cross-domain overlap degrades more than the within-domain precision comparison for both Qwen models, but not for Llama-3.2-1B. Matched-domain 4-bit recalibration reaches 90% of a split-half stability plateau at the smallest tested $n=8$ for both Qwen models and $n=32$ for Llama-3.2-1B, though not as a sharp threshold; for the two Qwen models, updating only selected layers does not reach the full-map stability criterion. On Jetson Orin NX, the 16-sample workload takes seconds for the two models with valid on-device sink measurements. The practical message is precise: global rankings often transfer, but discrete head sets, layer-local policies, and cross-domain calibration should be revalidated after quantization.

articles.titleCn: 全球排名得以保留，选定头部发生变动：在4位仅权重量化下的BOS-Sink拓扑结构
articles.abstractCn: 感知部署可以在模型量化之前识别重要的首标记注意力头，然后在边缘重用该映射。我们测试了这种捷径在4位NF4权重仅训练后量化（PTQ）中是否安全。我们的感知拓扑一致性（STC）指标将全局排名保留、top-k集合重叠和逐层感知质量转移分开，并区分了每输入敏感性和校准映射迁移。在Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B中，全局bf16至4位排名在4096个标记时仍然很高（ρ_s ≥ 0.980），但top-k Jaccard重叠仅为0.619-0.793，对应76.5-88.5%的成员保留率。全局统计也掩盖了局部失败：终端Qwen层偏移量是其模型均值的6.2-7.9倍，而Llama-3.2-1B显示低且近乎均匀的漂移。在C4至LongBench的转换下，跨域重叠的退化程度高于域内精度比较，这对Qwen模型有效，但对Llama-3.2-1B无效。匹配域的4位重新校准在两个Qwen模型中最小测试n=8时达到分半稳定性平台的90%，在Llama-3.2-1B中为n=32，尽管不是尖锐阈值；对于两个Qwen模型，仅更新选定层无法达到全图稳定性标准。在Jetson Orin NX上，16样本工作负载对具有有效边缘感知测量的两个模型仅需几秒钟。实际信息是明确的：全局排名通常可以迁移，但离散头集合、逐层策略和跨域校准应在量化后重新验证。

articles.title: ARID: A Deployable Edge AI System for Structured Information Extraction from Industrial Maintenance Work Orders
articles.abstract: Maintenance work orders must often be processed offline on embedded hardware, yet downstream software requires predictable structured output. We present ARID (Aviation-inspired Routing for Industrial Deployment), which extracts component, failure mode, symptom, and maintenance action into fixed-schema JSON on an 8 GB NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. ARID combines conservative dual-teacher filtering, targeted noise-aware synthesis, one routing decision per work order, 4-bit inference, and grammar-constrained decoding. From 2,326 unlabeled OMIn records, it retains 716 training pairs and adds 99 topology-constrained records targeting action extraction. On 300 human-labeled records, ARID reaches 84.8% token-F1 on the reference stack and 82.9% on the deployed Jetson. Resident serving achieves 5,310/5,656 ms P50/P99 at 12.5 W. On zero-shot MaintNet transfer, semantic F1 falls to 46.4% while parser success remains at least 99.8%, showing that output validity transfers but field semantics do not.

articles.titleCn: ARID：一种用于从工业维护工单中提取结构化信息的可部署边缘AI系统
articles.abstractCn: 维护工单通常需要在嵌入式硬件上离线处理，但下游软件需要可预测的结构化输出。我们提出了ARID（航空启发式路由用于工业部署），它在一个8 GB的NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上提取组件、故障模式、症状和维护操作，并将其转换为固定模式的JSON。ARID结合了保守的双教师过滤、有针对性的噪声感知合成、每个工单一个路由决策、4位推理和语法约束解码。从2,326条未标记的OMIn记录中，它保留了716个训练对，并添加了99条针对操作提取的拓扑约束记录。在300条人工标记的记录上，ARID在参考堆栈上达到84.8%的token-F1，在部署的Jetson上达到82.9%。驻留服务在12.5 W功耗下实现了5,310/5,656 ms的P50/P99。在零样本MaintNet迁移中，语义F1降至46.4%，而解析器成功率保持在至少99.8%，表明输出有效性可以迁移，但字段语义不能。

articles.title: Error-Supervised Synthetic Learner Writing for Automated Essay Scoring
articles.abstract: Synthetic essays can help reduce dependence on human-written data in Automated Essay Scoring (AES). However, they often lack realistic errors, limiting their ability to represent authentic human writing, particularly when the target texts are intended to resemble those produced by language learners. In this study, we present a simple approach that introduces error supervision into synthetic essay generation. Specifically, we fine-tune an LLM generator on error-annotated texts of the kind commonly used in Grammatical Error Detection (GED). To assess the utility of the proposed approach, we fine-tune and evaluate AES scorers under three data conditions: authentic essays, synthetic essays generated conventionally, and synthetic essays generated using our proposed approach. The results show that in the larger-data settings, the proposed approach outperforms the conventional synthetic baseline in 11 out of 12 dataset-metric comparisons, with performance in some cases approaching that of models trained on authentic essays. Despite these gains, performance under extremely low-resource settings remains mixed, with advantages over the conventional baseline only becoming more apparent at 200 training essays, although not consistently across datasets. Qualitative and quantitative analyses further show that the proposed approach produces learner-like errors whose distributions broadly resemble those observed in authentic essays.
articles.titleCn: 错误监督合成学习器用于自动作文评分
articles.abstractCn: 合成作文可以帮助减少自动作文评分（AES）对人工编写数据的依赖。然而，它们通常缺乏真实错误，限制了它们代表真实人类写作的能力，尤其是在目标文本旨在模仿语言学习者所产内容时。在本研究中，我们提出了一种简单的方法，将错误监督引入合成作文生成。具体而言，我们在通常用于语法错误检测（GED）的错误标注文本上微调了一个LLM生成器。为了评估所提出方法的效用，我们在三种数据条件下微调和评估了AES评分器：真实作文、传统方法生成的合成作文以及采用我们提出方法生成的合成作文。结果表明，在更大数据量的设置下，所提出的方法在12个数据集指标比较中的11个方面优于传统合成基线，在某些情况下其性能接近在真实作文上训练的模型。尽管有这些进步，但在极低资源设置下的性能仍然参差不齐，只有在训练作文达到200篇时，其相对于传统基线的优势才更加明显，尽管这种优势在不同数据集上并不始终一致。定性和定量分析进一步表明，所提出的方法生成的学习者式错误，其分布大致类似于真实作文中观察到的错误分布。

articles.title: VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks
articles.abstract: Coding agents operate on real repository coding tasks, and persistent memory systems promise to reuse experience across tasks. Yet existing evaluations do not show whether those systems improve executable repository work. Repository benchmarks test code changes but do not isolate memory, while memory benchmarks score recall without measuring downstream coding outcomes. We introduce VibeMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating memory systems on 111 coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repositories and 3,634 history trajectories from the target repositories. The targets follow the SWE benchmark style and cover bug fixes, feature requests, interface changes, and configuration work. An agent edits each target codebase under a declared memory condition. Executable tests decide task resolution. Each target is retained only when injected history experience improves its executable outcome in a reference setting, so every target carries a prior experience whose usefulness is verified by execution in that setting. The frozen verified experience is then transferred to five held-out solvers. Direct injection raises observed task resolution on four of them by 1.1 to 4.5 percentage points while lowering agent steps on all five. Yet when four existing memory systems must construct and retrieve experience from the same history, eleven of twelve solver and system pairings fail to exceed the matched memory-off baseline. VibeMemBench exposes the gap between the useful experience that repository history holds and the experience existing memory systems deliver for repository coding tasks.
articles.titleCn: VibeMemBench：评估真实代码库任务中为编码代理设计的内存系统
articles.abstractCn: 编码代理在真实的代码仓库任务上运行，而持久化内存系统承诺跨任务重用经验。然而现有评估并未证明这些系统能否提升可执行代码仓库工作的效率。代码仓库基准测试代码变更但无法隔离内存，而内存基准测试仅评分召回率而不衡量下游编码结果。我们引入了VibeMemBench，这是一个用于评估内存系统在90个SWE-rebench V2代码仓库的111个编码目标（涵盖bug修复、功能请求、接口变更和配置工作）以及这些目标仓库的3,634条历史轨迹上的性能的基准测试。这些目标遵循SWE基准风格，代理在声明的内存条件下编辑每个目标代码库，可执行测试决定任务解决情况。每个目标仅在注入的历史经验在参考设置中提升了其可执行结果时才被保留，因此每个目标都携带了经过该设置执行验证的有效经验。随后将冻结的验证经验转移给五个独立的求解器。直接注入使其中四个求解器的任务解决率提升了1.1至4.5个百分点，同时使所有五个求解器的代理步骤减少。然而，当四个现有内存系统必须从相同历史中构建和检索经验时，十二个求解器与系统组合中仅有一个未能超过匹配的内存关闭基线。VibeMemBench揭示了代码仓库历史中持有的有用经验与现有内存系统为代码仓库编码任务提供的经验之间的差距。

articles.title: Contributions to the hierarchy of probabilistic languages
articles.abstract: We reconsider the theory of probabilistic formal languages generated by n-gram models and by probabilistic context-free grammars (PCFGs). The expected hierarchy of probabilistic grammars is established by proving that every probabilistic language generated by an n-gram model is also generated by some PCFG, while some probabilistic languages generated by PCFGs cannot be generated by any $n$-gram model. We introduce the notion of fully connected PCFGs, namely PCFGs in Chomsky normal form where every production rule only involving non-terminals has non-zero probability. Our main result shows that any probabilistic language generated by an $n$-gram model differs from any probabilistic language generated by a fully connected PCFG. Therefore, the class of probabilistic languages generated by $n$-gram models is not a subset of the class generated by fully connected PCFGs.
articles.titleCn: 概率语言层次结构中的贡献
articles.abstractCn: 我们重新审视由n-gram模型和概率上下文无关文法（PCFG）生成的概率形式语言理论。通过证明由n-gram模型生成的每个概率语言也可以由某个PCFG生成，同时由PCFG生成的某些概率语言不能由任何n-gram模型生成，我们建立了概率文法的预期层次结构。我们引入了全连接PCFG的概念，即处于乔姆斯基范式中的PCFG，其中每个仅涉及非终端的产生式规则具有非零概率。我们的主要结果表明，由n-gram模型生成的任何概率语言都与由全连接PCFG生成的任何概率语言不同。因此，由n-gram模型生成的概率语言类不是由全连接PCFG生成的概率语言类的子集。

articles.title: Paragraph Boundaries Are Not White Space:Compression Depth as the Signature of Hierarchical Structure
articles.abstract: Standard positional encodings represent position as a one-dimensional reading-order coordinate, but reading order alone does not determine hierarchical textual structure. We use a hierarchical rotary positional encoding (hRoPE) that represents paragraph, sentence, and token indices as separate channels, hold the token sequence fixed, intervene on the paragraph coordinate p1, and measure cross-paragraph attention with a token-distance-exact estimator. Attention is compressed relative to a token-distance-matched baseline in every corpus, but compression alone is not diagnostic of true structure: an architecturally identical channel with density-matched random labels is compressed too, more shallowly. What distinguishes real structure is the depth of compression, which is greater and corpus-dependent while the control's is not. Comparing eight corpus-only quantities across three constructs (lexical persistence, paragraph length, embedding-based coherence), none fully reproduces the cross-corpus ordering of depth, though embedding-based coherence comes closest. Compression depth, not its location, is the reproducible signature of genuine paragraph structure in our setting.
articles.titleCn: 段落边界不是空白：压缩深度作为层次结构的特征
articles.abstractCn: 标准位置编码将位置表示为一种一维的阅读顺序坐标，但阅读顺序本身并不能决定层次化的文本结构。我们使用一种层次化旋转位置编码（hRoPE），将段落、句子和标记索引表示为不同的通道，保持标记序列固定，干预段落坐标p1，并使用标记距离精确估计器来测量跨段落注意力。在每种语料库中，注意力相对于标记距离匹配的基线被压缩，但仅压缩本身并不能诊断真实结构：一个具有相同架构的通道，如果其密度匹配的随机标签也会被压缩，且压缩得更浅。真正区分真实结构的是压缩的深度，这种深度是语料库依赖的，而对照实验的深度则不是。比较三种结构（词汇持久性、段落长度、基于嵌入的连贯性）中的八种语料库仅有的量，没有一种能完全重现跨语料库的压缩深度排序，尽管基于嵌入的连贯性最为接近。在我们的设置中，压缩深度，而非其位置，是真实段落结构的可重复特征。

articles.title: BabelArena: A Large-Scale Multilingual Benchmark for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows through tool use and interaction with users and environments. However, current agent evaluations are largely English-centric, limiting our understanding of agent capabilities in multilingual settings. We introduce BabelFlow, a benchmark-general agentic workflow that adapts existing agent benchmarks to new languages by analyzing runtime dependencies, coordinating structure-preserving translation, and combining multi-layer verification with human review to preserve task and evaluation semantics. Using BabelFlow, we construct BabelArena, a task-aligned benchmark comprising 16,146 instances derived from 702 canonical tasks across four benchmark families, 13 domains, and 23 languages. Experiments with five frontier models show that no single model dominates across benchmark families and that cross-language disparities extend well beyond task success. Lower-resource languages exhibit distinct failure patterns, with larger shares of tool-use and control-flow errors rather than answer-quality errors alone, pointing to gaps in reliable task execution across the resource levels of these languages. On the same tasks, agents in low-resource languages also consume substantially more tokens than in English (up to roughly twice the input) without proportional increases in interaction length, and language consistency degrades further on tasks requiring structured output, where switches are directed overwhelmingly toward English. We believe BabelArena provides a foundation for advancing research on reliable and efficient multilingual agents.
articles.titleCn: BabelArena：面向LLM智能体的超大规模多语言基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地通过工具使用和与用户及环境的交互来执行多步骤工作流程。然而，当前代理评估主要集中于英语，限制了我们对代理在多语言环境中的能力理解。我们介绍了BabelFlow，一个通用的基准化代理工作流程，它通过分析运行时依赖关系、协调结构保持翻译，并结合多层验证与人工审核来保留任务和评估语义，从而将现有代理基准适应到新语言中。使用BabelFlow，我们构建了BabelArena，这是一个任务对齐的基准，包含16,146个实例，这些实例源自四个基准系列、13个领域和23种语言的702个规范任务。五款前沿模型的实验表明，没有单一模型能在所有基准系列中占据主导地位，且跨语言差异远超任务成功。低资源语言表现出独特的失败模式，工具使用和控制流错误的比例远高于答案质量问题，这表明在这些语言的资源水平上，可靠的任务执行存在差距。在相同任务上，低资源语言的代理消耗的token数量也远高于英语（高达输入的两倍），且交互长度没有相应增加，而在需要结构化输出的任务上，语言一致性进一步下降，转换几乎完全转向英语。我们相信BabelArena为推进可靠高效的多元语言代理研究提供了基础。

articles.title: RPMem: Learning Long-Term Recurrent Parametric Memory Across Sessions for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Long-running LLM agents require memory that persists and evolves across sessions. Text-based memory retrieves and reconstructs past interactions at every query, making long-horizon performance increasingly dependent on retrieval quality and contextual reasoning as histories grow. Parametric memory encodes experience directly into model computation, but existing approaches provide limited support for cross-session memory evolution. Their coupling to a specific backbone further restricts memory reuse after model replacement. We introduce RPMem, a two-stage architecture that compiles each session into a model-independent latent memory through forward computation and selectively integrates it with retained memory via a task-trained recurrent gate. The consolidated memory is then mapped to backbone-specific low-rank adaptation (LoRA) parameters, allowing the encoding capability to transfer when the backbone is replaced. Evaluation across three long-term memory benchmarks and five diverse backbones demonstrates broad generalization with near-constant update cost and memory footprint. With Qwen3-8B on PERMA, RPMem reaches 85.52%, outperforming the strongest parametric and text-based baselines by 5.32 and 12.98 percentage points, respectively. Ablations validate the complementary roles of session compilation and cross-session consolidation, while dynamics analyses reveal that the gate acquires task-specific memory integration strategies. These results establish RPMem as a lifecycle-independent parametric memory framework that maintains evolving cross-session memory that remains reusable across backbone replacements. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main.
articles.titleCn: RPMem：跨会话学习用于LLM智能体的长期递归参数化记忆
articles.abstractCn: 长时间运行的LLM代理需要跨会话持续且演变的内存。基于文本的内存通过每次查询检索和重构过去的交互，使得随着历史记录的增长，长时程性能越来越依赖于检索质量和上下文推理。参数化内存将经验直接编码到模型计算中，但现有方法对跨会话内存演化的支持有限，并且它们与特定主干模型的耦合进一步限制了模型替换后的内存重用。我们引入了RPMem，一种两阶段架构，通过正向计算将每个会话编译为与模型无关的潜在内存，并通过任务训练的循环门控选择性地将其与保留内存集成。整合后的内存随后映射到主干模型特定的低秩适配（LoRA）参数，使得编码能力在主干模型替换时能够迁移。在三个长期记忆基准测试和五种不同的主干模型上的评估展示了广泛的泛化能力，更新成本和内存占用几乎保持恒定。在PERMA上使用Qwen3-8B，RPMem达到了85.52%，分别比最强的参数化和基于文本的基线高5.32和12.98个百分点。消融实验验证了会话编译和跨会话整合的互补作用，而动态分析揭示了门控获得了特定任务的内存集成策略。这些结果确立了RPMem作为一个与生命周期无关的参数化内存框架，该框架能够维持演变的跨会话内存，并在主干模型替换后保持重用性。我们的实现代码可在https://github.com/Quark-Medical/rpmem/tree/main获取。

articles.title: Propose, Verify, Commit: Evidence-Grounded Memory for Long-Horizon Multi-Actor Conversations
articles.abstract: Long-horizon conversational memory is especially challenging in multi-actor settings, where relevant evidence is distributed across participants and contexts and previously established information may later be revised. We introduce EGMEMORY, which formulates long-horizon multi-actor memory as a searchable state machine that separates persistent message-level evidence from an explicit active state. At write time, adaptive state resolution and an evidence-grounded propose-verify-commit protocol govern how this state evolves. At read time, adaptive evidence navigation iteratively resolves the state and supporting evidence required for a query, using conversational structure to narrow the search space and lexical-semantic relevance to rank candidates. The system operates through prompting and tool use without memory-specific policy training. EGMEMORY achieves 68.2% on GroupMemBench and 77.9% on EverMemBench, outperforming the strongest evaluated baselines by 22.7 and 21.4 percentage points, respectively. It further reaches 73.6% on the dyadic LoCoMo benchmark, demonstrating generalization beyond multi-actor conversations. We will release the codebase upon formal publication.
articles.titleCn: 提出、验证、提交：基于证据的长期多角色对话记忆
articles.abstractCn: 在多参与者场景中，长时程对话记忆尤其具有挑战性，因为相关证据分散在参与者和不同情境中，而先前建立的信息可能随后被修订。我们引入了 EGMEMORY，将长时程多参与者记忆构建为一个可搜索的状态机，将持久的消息级证据与显式的活跃状态分离。在写入时，自适应状态解析和基于证据的提议-验证-提交协议控制该状态如何演变。在读取时，自适应证据导航迭代解析查询所需的状态和支撑证据，利用对话结构缩小搜索范围，并使用词汇语义相关性对候选者进行排序。该系统通过提示和工具使用来运行，无需特定于记忆的策略训练。EGMEMORY 在 GroupMemBench 上达到 68.2% 的成绩，在 EverMemBench 上达到 77.9%，分别比最强的评估基线高出 22.7 和 21.4 个百分点。它进一步在二元 LoCoMo 基准上达到 73.6%，展示了超越多参与者对话的泛化能力。我们将代码库在正式发表后发布。

articles.title: Perplexity Predicts Protection: Choosing Pretrained Backbones for Worst-Client Fairness in Federated Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: Federated learning lets multiple parties train a shared model without pooling their data, but a client with far less data than the others can end up poorly served even when the group's average accuracy looks fine. We ask whether the choice of pretrained backbone affects this under LoRA fine-tuning, and whether per-word perplexity on the target text predicts which backbone helps the worst-off client before federated training starts. We ran 313 experiments across three text-classification datasets and three similarly sized backbones (RoBERTa, BERTweet, PubMedBERT), each compared against a task-specific baseline on identical data splits. Lower-perplexity backbones consistently produced larger gains for the worst-performing client, with a rank correlation of -0.87 across nine dataset-backbone pairs; a backbone held out of the analysis confirmed the pattern. Personalization with Ditto recovered only 4-12% of the gap between training alone and full federation, and removing aggregation entirely erased the benefit. A client's update also showed no sign of conflicting with the group's update; the two are close to orthogonal, ruling out one proposed explanation for this failure. Practically: measure perplexity on a sample of task text before choosing a backbone, and do not rely on personalization to protect a data-poor client. We release our code, predictions, and full results for others to test.
articles.titleCn: 困惑度预测保护：为联邦参数高效微调中的最差客户端公平性选择预训练骨干网络
articles.abstractCn: 联邦学习允许多个参与方在不共享数据的情况下训练共享模型，但数据量远少于其他参与方的客户端最终可能得不到良好服务，即使整个群体的平均准确率看起来不错。我们探究了预训练主干网络的选择是否会影响LoRA微调的效果，以及目标文本的每词困惑度是否能在联邦训练开始前预测哪个主干网络对最不利的客户端影响最差。我们在三个文本分类数据集和三个规模相似的骨干网络（RoBERTa、BERTweet、PubMedBERT）上进行了313次实验，每个骨干网络都在相同的数据划分上与特定任务的基线进行了比较。低困惑度的骨干网络始终为表现最差的客户端带来了更大的增益，九个数据集-骨干网络组合的秩相关系数为-0.87；被排除在分析之外的骨干网络证实了这一模式。使用Ditto进行个性化仅恢复了单独训练与完全联邦化之间差距的4-12%，而完全移除聚合则消除了这一优势。客户端的更新也没有显示出与群体更新的冲突迹象；两者几乎正交，排除了该失败的一个提议解释。实际应用中：在选择骨干网络前，在任务文本样本上测量困惑度，并且不要依赖个性化来保护数据量较少的客户端。我们发布了我们的代码、预测和完整结果供他人验证。

articles.title: Long-Tail Rebalancing for Non-Verbal Vocalization-Aware ASR: A Track~1 System for the NVVSpeech Challenge
articles.abstract: Non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) carry important paralinguistic information but are often omitted by conventional automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. The ISCSLP NVVSpeech Challenge requires joint transcription of lexical content and 16 NVV categories under limited and highly imbalanced supervision. We present a data-centric NVV-aware ASR pipeline based on cross-dataset label harmonization and a two-stage sampling schedule. We map heterogeneous source labels to the official taxonomy and exclude samples without a reliable mapping. Our schedule first uses square-root category sampling to moderate the long-tailed distribution and then applies uniform-category fine-tuning. On a fixed local validation split, square-root category sampling performs best among the tested single-stage settings. The final two-stage system obtains an official score of 63.86 and ranks fourth in Track 1.
articles.comment: Accepted by ISCSLP 2026, NVVSpeech Challenge Track 1
articles.titleCn: 非语言发声感知语音识别的非语言长尾再平衡：NVVSpeech挑战赛Track~1系统
articles.abstractCn: 非语言发声（NVV）携带重要的副语言信息，但传统自动语音识别（ASR）系统通常会忽略这些信息。ISCSLP NVVSpeech挑战赛要求在有限的、高度不平衡的监督下，对词汇内容和16类NVV进行联合转录。我们提出了一种以数据为中心的、具有NVV感知能力的ASR流程，该流程基于跨数据集标签协调和两阶段采样计划。我们将异构源标签映射到官方分类体系，并排除了无法进行可靠映射的样本。我们的采样计划首先使用平方根类别采样来调节长尾分布，然后应用均匀类别微调。在固定的本地验证分割上，平方根类别采样在测试的单阶段设置中表现最佳。最终的两阶段系统获得了63.86的官方分数，并在Track 1中排名第四。

articles.title: PSD: Pseudo Self-Distillation of Memory Representation Capabilities for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Memory systems are becoming a core component of LLM agents, but constructing and maintaining memory remains expensive because it relies on repeated calls to large proprietary language models. This cost creates a major barrier to deploying memory-enhanced agents at scale. In this paper, we present Pseudo Self-Distillation (PSD), a framework that enables small language models (SLMs) to construct hierarchical memory representations by distilling behavior from a strong black-box oracle through a multi-stage training pipeline. Standard distillation methods require access to teacher logits or hidden states, which closed models do not expose. Unlike conventional self-distillation settings, where supervision is derived from a model's own predictions, sampled rollouts, or aggregated outputs, PSD enables a single-model distillation setup while channeling external oracle knowledge through the prompt. PSD uses a single small model in two roles: a teacher that sees a privileged prompt containing the oracle's answer as reference context, and a student that sees only the task prompt. The student learns to reproduce the teacher's output distribution, absorbing oracle-guided behavior into its own weights without accessing the oracle's internals. On LoCoMo, PSD-trained Qwen3-0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B match or exceed GPT-4.1-mini on downstream retrieval at a fraction of the deployment cost, with off-policy PSD achieving the strongest results across most conditions. We further show that this memory-construction capability transfers out-of-distribution to LongMemEval, despite the students being trained exclusively on LoCoMo with no exposure to LongMemEval data.
articles.titleCn: PSD：面向大型语言模型代理的记忆表征能力伪自蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 记忆系统正成为大型语言模型代理的核心组件，但构建和维护记忆仍然昂贵，因为它依赖于对大型专有语言模型的重复调用。这种成本为大规模部署记忆增强代理构成了重大障碍。在本文中，我们提出了伪自蒸馏（PSD）框架，该框架通过多阶段训练流程，使小型语言模型（SLM）能够通过从强黑盒预言机蒸馏行为来构建分层记忆表示。标准蒸馏方法需要访问教师逻辑或隐藏状态，但封闭模型并不公开这些信息。与传统的自蒸馏设置不同，在传统的自蒸馏设置中，监督信息来源于模型的自身预测、采样滚动或聚合输出，而PSD能够实现单模型蒸馏配置，同时通过提示传递外部预言机知识。PSD使用单个小型模型担任两个角色：一个教师角色，它看到一个包含预言机答案作为参考上下文的特权提示，以及一个学生角色，它只看到任务提示。学生学习复制教师的输出分布，将预言机引导的行为吸收到自己的权重中，而无需访问预言机内部。在LoCoMo上，PSD训练的Qwen3-0.6B、1.7B和4B在下游检索任务中表现与GPT-4.1-mini相当或更优，且部署成本更低，离线策略的PSD在大多数条件下取得了最佳结果。我们进一步证明，这种记忆构建能力能够泛化到LongMemEval，尽管学生仅在LoCoMo上训练，且未接触过LongMemEval数据。

articles.title: Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks
articles.abstract: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical. However, existing benchmarks for multi-omics sequence tasks rely on classification and regression metrics, neglecting whether models grasp the underlying biological evidence. We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals an inverse relationship: while scientific LLMs outperform general-purpose LLMs in sequence classification accuracy, they fail to provide valid evidence to support their predictions. One plausible interpretation is shortcut learning: specialized models may rely on statistical patterns rather than the biological mechanisms needed for scientific discovery. Motivated by this finding, we introduce tool-augmented on-policy distillation (TA-OPD), a post-training method to align sequence prediction with evidence-grounded biological reasoning. Across five Qwen3.5 models spanning 0.8B to 27B parameters, TA-OPD consistently strengthens biological evidence grounding while improving predictive performance on most tasks. These gains persist across model scales, indicating that stronger sequence reasoning does not arise solely from increased model capacity, but can be improved through evidence-aware training. Together, OmicsBench and TA-OPD provide a framework for diagnosing reasoning failures in multi-omics LLMs and a path toward models whose predictions are better grounded in biologically meaningful evidence.
articles.titleCn: 基于序列的组学任务中，面向大型语言模型的领域自适应的基于工具增强的在线策略蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 多组学序列包含复杂的生物模式，然而解读其机制以实现自动化科学发现仍具挑战性。随着大型语言模型（LLMs）对这些序列进行解读，评估其预测结果和科学推理能力至关重要。然而，现有的多组学序列任务基准主要依赖分类和回归指标，忽视了模型是否理解其背后的生物证据。我们引入OmicsBench，这是首个针对多组学序列推理的基准，包含跨越DNA调控、RNA处理和蛋白质功能六个任务的1,160个专家验证问题。OmicsBench要求提供可追溯的证据链，并使用领域专家开发的实例特定评分标准进行评估。对17个LLMs的评估揭示了一种反向关系：虽然科学LLMs在序列分类准确度上优于通用LLMs，但它们无法提供有效的证据来支持其预测。一种可能的解释是捷径学习：专业模型可能依赖统计模式而非科学发现所需的生物机制。基于这一发现，我们引入了工具增强的在线策略蒸馏（TA-OPD），这是一种后训练方法，旨在将序列预测与基于证据的生物推理相统一。在参数规模从0.8B到27B的五个Qwen3.5模型上，TA-OPD始终如一地增强了生物证据基础，同时在大多数任务上提升了预测性能。这些收益在不同模型规模上持续存在，表明更强的序列推理并非仅源于模型容量的增加，而是可以通过证据感知训练来提升。OmicsBench和TA-OPD共同提供了一个诊断多组学LLMs推理失败的框架，并指明了构建预测结果更基于生物意义证据的模型路径。

articles.title: MuLA-Bench: A Multilingual Long-Form Audio Understanding Benchmark via Multi-Tier Auditing
articles.abstract: Long-form audio performance is often summarized by context length and aggregate accuracy, obscuring how language, evidence, and task jointly shape difficulty. We introduce MuLA-Bench: 5,038 open-ended questions over 1,769 in-the-wild recordings totaling 1,377.9 hours, covering 16 languages and eight domains. A balanced Language x Domain semantic track supports controlled comparisons, while a complementary acoustic track preserves naturally occurring non-speech evidence. Evidence-grounded generation, shortcut checks, and language-expert review provide auditable questions without translating a shared source set or injecting target sounds. We evaluate ten audio-language models and conduct pooled diagnostics on a fixed eight-model cohort. Language rankings change across domains and tasks; acoustic-semantic performance gaps vary with the requested operation; and temporal errors can persist after the correct event is identified. Long-range retrieval is comparatively strong, while precise clock alignment and factual grounding of natural acoustic events remain fragile. MuLA-Bench thus exposes conditional failure patterns that a single long-context score does not capture.
articles.titleCn: MuLA-Bench：一个多语言长音频理解的多层审计基准
articles.abstractCn: 长音频表演通常通过上下文长度和综合准确率进行总结，从而掩盖了语言、证据和任务如何共同塑造难度的过程。我们介绍了MuLA-Bench：包含5038个开放式问题，覆盖1769段自然场景录音，总时长达1377.9小时，涉及16种语言和8个领域。一个平衡的语言×领域语义轨道支持受控比较，而一个补充的声学轨道则保留了自然发生的非语音证据。基于证据的生成、捷径检查和语言专家审查提供了可审计的问题，无需翻译共享的源集或注入目标声音。我们评估了十个音频语言模型，并对一个固定的八模型队列进行了联合诊断。语言排名在不同领域和任务中发生变化；声学-语义性能差距随所请求的操作而变化；时间错误可能在正确事件被识别后仍然存在。长距离检索相对较强，而精确的时钟校准和自然声学事件的事实基础仍然脆弱。因此，MuLA-Bench揭示了单一长上下文评分无法捕捉的条件性失败模式。

articles.title: One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents
articles.abstract: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. Same-origin category experts alternate long-horizon Agentic-miniRL with Refresh-Repair-Expand (RRE): the updated policy refreshes instance mastery, reuses its own verified successful trajectories for Repair SFT, and reselects tasks for further RL. Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference. Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets. We evaluate Pooled RL and Balanced RL, expert development, and single-model integration through aggregate and per-category resolution, the minimum category lift over each joint-RL baseline, and expert-gain recovery. The final MOPD policy achieves mean resolution of 58.04% on Pro-618 and 59.00% on SWE-bench Multilingual, improving over the base model by 5.39 and 2.78 percentage points, respectively.
articles.comment: 44 pages, including appendices. Model available at https://huggingface.co/Logics-MLLM/Logics-SWE-Qwen3.6-27B
articles.titleCn: 面向软件工程智能体的类别感知迭代专家训练：从一到多，从多到一
articles.abstractCn: 仓库级软件工程（SWE）包含异构任务类别，在集中式代理强化学习下，其进展可能不均衡：某些类别的收益与另一些类别的衰退同时发生，而总体解决率则掩盖了这些变化。受此类别跷跷板的启发，我们开发了一个类别感知专家训练与策略整合框架。可执行任务构建和SWE标签器——一个基于证据的多轴标签系统——组织训练池。初始的类别特定强化学习提升了平均训练成功率，但留下了不均衡的实例级进展，这促使我们明确整合成功行为并采用策略自适应任务选择。同源类别专家交替进行长时程代理迷你强化学习与刷新-修复-扩展（RRE）：更新的策略刷新实例掌握程度，重用其自身验证过的成功轨迹进行修复式小步强化学习，并重新选择任务进行进一步强化学习。标签路由的多导师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将专家整合为一个可部署的学生，ReLU门控的奖励外推仅保留每个导师相对于参考的改进方向。专家训练和策略整合无需外部模型提供解决方案轨迹或动作目标。我们通过总体和按类别解决率、每个联合强化学习基线的最小类别提升以及专家增益恢复，评估了集中式强化学习、平衡式强化学习、专家开发和单模型整合。最终的MOPD策略在Pro-618上实现了58.04%的平均解决率，在SWE-bench多语言测试上实现了59.00%，分别比基础模型提升了5.39和2.78个百分点。

articles.title: Machine-Interpretable Information: Compiling Documents into Searchable and Readable Protocol States
articles.abstract: Long-context language models interface with external knowledge through raw natural language. In retrieval-augmented systems, this creates a persistent index-payload schism: dense vectors enable searchable routing, but models must re-ingest lengthy text payloads for reasoning at O(N^2) attention cost. Existing compression methods further produce private states tied to specific architectures. We introduce Machine-Interpretable Information (MII), the first agent-to-agent (A2A) document-to-state protocol. A dual-timescale state-space Writer compiles documents into a canonical, fixed-bandwidth state (56 tokens), and a lightweight Translator maps it into any frozen Reader's embedding space, reducing query-time cost to O(K). The resulting .mii artifact unifies Retrieval (searchable geometry), Reasoning (global memory), and Reconstruction (grounded details) in a single transferable medium. We demonstrate strong cross-model interoperability across heterogeneous LLMs (e.g., Llama, Qwen, Mistral) -- despite the Writer using a legacy GPT-2 vocabulary, forcing genuine semantic translation rather than token-level memorization. Mechanistic probes reveal modular latent structure: entity representations can be causally traced and zero-shot transplanted between unrelated document states while remaining decodable. To address lexical reconstruction under fixed bandwidth, we propose Residual-MII, a cache hierarchy combining compiled global memory with sparse local evidence. On HotpotQA (7,405 queries), Residual-MII exceeds full-context Exact Match at approximately 7% of the attention FLOPs, suggesting a paradigm shift toward compiled, transferable neural document formats.
articles.titleCn: 机器可解释信息：将文档编译为可搜索和可读的协议状态
articles.abstractCn: 长上下文语言模型通过原始自然语言与外部知识交互。在检索增强系统中，这造成了持久的索引-有效载荷分裂：密集向量支持可搜索路由，但模型必须以O(N^2)的注意力成本重新摄取长文本有效载荷进行推理。现有的压缩方法进一步产生了与特定架构相关的私有状态。我们引入了机器可解释信息（MII），这是首个代理间（A2A）文档到状态的协议。一个双时间尺度状态空间写入器将文档编译为规范化的固定带宽状态（56个标记），而一个轻量级翻译器将其映射到任何冻结的读取器的嵌入空间，将查询时间成本降低到O(K)。生成的.mii工件将检索（可搜索的几何形状）、推理（全局内存）和重建（基于的细节）统一在单一可传输媒介中。我们在异构大型语言模型（例如，Llama、Qwen、Mistral）之间展示了强大的跨模型互操作性——尽管写入器使用了一个过时的GPT-2词汇表，迫使进行真正的语义翻译而不是标记级别的记忆。机制探查揭示了模块化的潜在结构：实体表示可以被因果追踪，并在不相关的文档状态之间零样本移植，同时保持可解码性。为了解决固定带宽下的词汇重建问题，我们提出了残差-MII，这是一个缓存层次结构，结合了编译的全局内存和稀疏的本地证据。在HotpotQA（7,405个查询）上，残差-MII在约7%的注意力FLOPs下超过了全上下文精确匹配，表明了向编译的、可传输的神经文档格式的范式转变。

articles.title: LLM-Based FORM Code Generation with Verification-Driven Fine-Tuning
articles.abstract: FORM is a domain-specific symbolic manipulation language widely used in particle physics for processing the very large algebraic expressions arising from multi-loop Feynman diagram calculations. Despite its central role in precision theoretical physics, no artificial-intelligence tooling exists, to our knowledge, for assisting physicists in writing FORM code. We show that contemporary large language models (LLMs), including frontier models with hundreds of billions of parameters, achieve a zero-percent execution pass rate on our instruction-following and tutorial-style FORM tasks without documentation in a single attempt, establishing FORM as a genuine zero-shot language for LLMs at the time of writing. We then present a verification-driven data generation pipeline that uses the FORM binary itself as an execution oracle to produce and validate a corpus of 4,633 training examples spanning deterministic computations, open-ended programs, tutorial code, and knowledge question-answer pairs. Fine-tuning a compact open-weights model (Qwen3-8B) with quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) yields a specialist that, evaluated on four complementary benchmarks (840 tasks, single attempt each), decisively outperforms frontier models with up to 756B parameters in execution rate and in strict, FORM-verified output matching on the larger benchmarks, and remains statistically indistinguishable from them on the smaller, harder ones. General reasoning and coding capabilities are preserved within 2.6 percentage points.
articles.titleCn: 基于LLM的FORM代码生成与验证驱动微调
articles.abstractCn: FORM是一种专门用于符号操作的领域特定语言，在粒子物理学中广泛用于处理多圈费曼图计算产生的巨大代数表达式。尽管它在精密理论物理学中扮演着核心角色，但据我们所知，目前还没有人工智能工具能够协助物理学家编写FORM代码。我们证明，当代大型语言模型（LLMs），包括拥有数百亿参数的前沿模型，在单次尝试中，在我们的指令遵循和教程式FORM任务上实现了零执行通过率，在没有文档的情况下，将FORM确立为当时LLMs的真正零样本语言。然后，我们提出了一种以验证驱动的数据生成管道，该管道使用FORM二进制文件本身作为执行预言机，生成并验证了包含4,633个训练示例的语料库，这些示例涵盖了确定性计算、开放式程序、教程代码以及知识问答对。使用量化低秩适配（QLoRA）对紧凑型开放权重模型（Qwen3-8B）进行微调，得到一个专家模型，在四个互补基准（840个任务，每个任务单次尝试）上的评估结果显示，该模型在执行速度和大型基准上的严格FORM验证输出匹配方面，显著优于参数高达756B的前沿模型，并且在小型、更难的基准上，其表现与前沿模型在统计上没有区别。通用推理和编码能力保持在2.6个百分点以内。

articles.title: Knowing When to Trust Images: Reliability-Aware Multi-modal Entity Alignment
articles.abstract: The visual modality, i.e., images, plays a key role in multi-modal entity alignment (MMEA). Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.
articles.titleCn: 知道何时信任图像：可靠性感知多模态实体对齐
articles.abstractCn: 视觉模态，即图像，在多模态实体对齐（MMEA）中发挥着关键作用。现有方法通常直接将图像与其他模态融合以对齐不同实体。尽管简单，但此类策略忽略了图像中的潜在噪声及其与对应实体的语义不匹配，导致融合效果不佳和性能下降。为此，我们提出了一种新的可靠性感知框架用于MMEA（RA-MMEA），该框架评估视觉可靠性并自适应地改进不可靠的视觉表示以实现鲁棒的实体对齐。其核心在于两个模块，包括依赖感知视觉可靠性预测（DA-VRP）和稳定性正则化的视觉嵌入生成（SR-VEG）。前者旨在利用实体内部的多模态依赖关系来估计图像的可靠性，而后者则侧重于基于文本模态编码的语义生成替代视觉表示以进行多模态融合。与当前方法相比，RA-MMEA能够为模态融合提供更可靠的视觉表示，从而提升性能。在广泛的实验中，RA-MMEA取得了最先进的结果，验证了可靠视觉模态对实体对齐的重要性以及RA-MMEA的有效性。代码和结果将公开。

articles.title: Judging a Review by its Cover: A Reliability Analysis of LLM-based Peer Review Evaluation Metrics
articles.abstract: Peer-review evaluation is increasingly being automated with LLM-as-a-judge metrics, but this creates a measurement risk. A review may receive a high score because it is fluent, organized, and polished, rather than because it provides a strong evaluation of the paper. This risk is especially important in AI-assisted reviewing, where reviewers may use LLMs to improve clarity or presentation while preserving the underlying judgments. We propose a statistical framework for testing whether peer-review evaluation metrics capture substantive review quality beyond surface-level linguistic form. The framework compares original human reviews with faithful LLM rewrites that preserve the same evaluative content while changing wording and presentation. Using a dataset comprising 4,044 meaning-preserving rewrites derived from 674 human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS, we evaluate 29 content-oriented peer-review evaluation metrics drawn from four prior works through complementary tests of surface sensitivity and robustness. Although these metrics are intended to capture review properties beyond surface-level, writing-dependent characteristics, we find that sensitivity to rewriting is widespread. Under our primary analysis, 23 metrics assign significantly different scores to reviews whose evaluative content is preserved, while only six satisfy our robustness criterion. The patterns are largely consistent across two LLM judge models, suggesting that the issue is not specific to a single judge. These findings show that many peer-review evaluation metrics partially conflate review quality with linguistic presentation, and indicate that robustness to meaning-preserving rewriting should be validated before such metrics are used to compare human-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated reviews.
articles.titleCn: 以封面评判评论：基于LLM的同行评审评估指标的可靠性分析
articles.abstractCn: 同行评审评估正越来越多地通过LLM作为评判者的指标实现自动化，但这带来了测量风险。评审可能因为流畅、条理清晰和精炼而获得高分，而不是因为它对论文提供了有力的评估。这种风险在AI辅助评审中尤为重要，评审者可能使用LLM来提高清晰度或呈现方式，同时保留基本判断。我们提出了一种统计框架，用于测试同行评审评估指标是否在超越表面语言形式的实质性评审质量方面进行捕捉。该框架将原始人类评审与忠实于LLM改写进行比较，这些改写保留了相同的评估内容，但改变了措辞和呈现方式。使用一个包含来自ICLR和NeurIPS的674份人类评审衍生的4,044个意义保持改写的数据集，我们通过表面敏感性和鲁棒性的互补测试评估了来自四项先前工作的29个内容导向的同行评审评估指标。尽管这些指标旨在捕捉超越表面层、依赖写作的特性之外的评审属性，但我们发现对改写的敏感性普遍存在。在我们的主要分析中，23个指标对评估内容保持不变的评审分配了显著不同的分数，而只有六个满足我们的鲁棒性标准。这些模式在两个LLM评判者模型中大体一致，表明问题并非特定于单个评判者。这些发现表明，许多同行评审评估指标部分地将评审质量与语言呈现混淆，并表明在使用这些指标比较人类撰写、AI辅助和AI生成的评审之前，应验证其对意义保持改写的鲁棒性。

articles.title: CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning
articles.abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3-24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series where adaptive correction provides limited additional benefit.

articles.titleCn: 基于控制的时序预测方法：基于大型语言模型的残差学习
articles.abstractCn: 时间序列预测在各个领域的关键决策中发挥着基础性作用。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）提供了有前景的推理能力，但现有的基于LLM的时间序列预测方法要么将其简化为忽略其优势的数值预测器，要么允许直接生成预测，这在非平稳设置中会破坏预测稳定性。我们引入了CTRL，这是一个将语义推理与定量预测解耦的框架。冻结的主干生成基础预测，而专门设计的LLM代理作为控制器，通过分解的趋势、季节性和不规则成分分析主干预测误差，将推理建立在可解释的时间结构之上。每个代理输出紧凑的控制信号，由轻量级残差解码器将其转换为预测修正。CTRL结合了无标签的测试时适应，仅通过输入统计数据检测分布偏移，并通过缓存仅使用3-24次LLM调用重新适配控制信号。CTRL明确设计用于在非平稳时间动态和分布偏移下提高鲁棒性，同时在高度平稳的时间序列上保持竞争力，因为在这些序列中自适应修正提供的额外益处有限。
